Generated Narrative: StructureMap SMNGSReport

map "https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureMap/sm-ngs-report" = "SMNGSReport"

uses "https://dnpm-dip.net/fhir/StructureDefinition/dnpm-lm-patient-record" alias DNPMPatientRecord as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle" alias Bundle as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport" alias DiagnosticReport as produced
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Observation" alias Observation as produced

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Root group: iterate over all ngsReports in the PatientRecord
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group NGSReports(source src : DNPMPatientRecord, target bundle : Bundle) {
  src -> bundle.type = 'collection' "bundleType";
  src.ngsReports as ngs ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('DiagnosticReport') as dr then {
    ngs.id as ngsid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', ngsid) "fullUrl";
    ngs -> dr then MapNGSReport(ngs, dr, bundle) "map";
  } "ngsReport";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapNGSReport: one DNPM NGS report → DiagnosticReport + child Observations
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapNGSReport(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : DiagnosticReport, target bundle : Bundle) {
  // ---- DiagnosticReport header ----
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "drId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "drStatus";
  // Profile declaration
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-ngs-bericht' "drProfile";
  } "drMeta";
  // Subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "drSubjectRef";
  } "drSubject";
  // Specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as s then {
    spec.id as sid -> s.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "drSpecimenRef";
  } "drSpecimen";
  // Issued (date → instant)
  src.issuedOn as d -> tgt.issued = append(d, 'T00:00:00Z') "drIssued";
  // ---- NGS type → code ----
  src.type as t -> tgt.code as c then {
    t -> c.coding as coding then {
      t.code as codeV -> coding.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "typeCode";
      t.system as systemV -> coding.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "typeSystem";
      t.display as displayV -> coding.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "typeDisplay";
    } "typeCoding";
  } "drCode";
  // =========================================================================
  // TMB (Mutationslast)
  // =========================================================================
  src.results as r -> bundle then {
    r.tmb as tmb ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      tmb.id as tmbid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', tmbid) "fullUrl";
      tmb -> obs then MapTMB(tmb, obs) "map";
    } "tmbEntry";
  } "tmbResults";
  // Reference from DiagnosticReport.result
  src.results as r -> tgt then {
    r.tmb as tmb -> tgt.result as res then {
      tmb.id as tid -> res.reference = append('urn:uuid:', tid) "tmbResultRef";
    } "tmbResult";
  } "tmbResultsRef";
  // =========================================================================
  // BRCAness
  // =========================================================================
  src.results as r -> bundle then {
    r.brcaness as brca ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      brca.id as brcaid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', brcaid) "fullUrl";
      brca -> obs then MapBRCAness(brca, obs) "map";
    } "brcaEntry";
  } "brcaResults";
  src.results as r -> tgt then {
    r.brcaness as brca -> tgt.result as res then {
      brca.id as bid -> res.reference = append('urn:uuid:', bid) "brcaResultRef";
    } "brcaResult";
  } "brcaResultsRef";
  // =========================================================================
  // HRD Score
  // =========================================================================
  src.results as r -> bundle then {
    r.hrdScore as hrd ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      hrd.id as hrdid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', hrdid) "fullUrl";
      hrd -> obs then MapHRDScore(hrd, obs) "map";
    } "hrdEntry";
  } "hrdResults";
  src.results as r -> tgt then {
    r.hrdScore as hrd -> tgt.result as res then {
      hrd.id as hid -> res.reference = append('urn:uuid:', hid) "hrdResultRef";
    } "hrdResult";
  } "hrdResultsRef";
  // =========================================================================
  // Simple Variants (SNVs / Indels)
  // =========================================================================
  src.results as r -> bundle then {
    r.simpleVariants as sv ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      sv.id as svid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', svid) "fullUrl";
      sv -> obs then MapSimpleVariant(sv, obs, src) "map";
    } "svEntry";
  } "svResults";
  src.results as r -> tgt then {
    r.simpleVariants as sv -> tgt.result as res then {
      sv.id as svid -> res.reference = append('urn:uuid:', svid) "svResultRef";
    } "svResult";
  } "svResultsRef";
  // =========================================================================
  // Copy Number Variants
  // =========================================================================
  src.results as r -> bundle then {
    r.copyNumberVariants as cnv ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      cnv.id as cnvid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', cnvid) "fullUrl";
      cnv -> obs then MapCNV(cnv, obs, src) "map";
    } "cnvEntry";
  } "cnvResults";
  src.results as r -> tgt then {
    r.copyNumberVariants as cnv -> tgt.result as res then {
      cnv.id as cid -> res.reference = append('urn:uuid:', cid) "cnvResultRef";
    } "cnvResult";
  } "cnvResultsRef";
  // =========================================================================
  // DNA Fusions
  // =========================================================================
  src.results as r -> bundle then {
    r.dnaFusions as df ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      df.id as dfid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', dfid) "fullUrl";
      df -> obs then MapDNAFusion(df, obs, src) "map";
    } "dfEntry";
  } "dfResults";
  src.results as r -> tgt then {
    r.dnaFusions as df -> tgt.result as res then {
      df.id as did -> res.reference = append('urn:uuid:', did) "dfResultRef";
    } "dfResult";
  } "dfResultsRef";
  // =========================================================================
  // RNA Fusions
  // =========================================================================
  src.results as r -> bundle then {
    r.rnaFusions as rf ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      rf.id as rfid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', rfid) "fullUrl";
      rf -> obs then MapRNAFusion(rf, obs, src) "map";
    } "rfEntry";
  } "rfResults";
  src.results as r -> tgt then {
    r.rnaFusions as rf -> tgt.result as res then {
      rf.id as rid -> res.reference = append('urn:uuid:', rid) "rfResultRef";
    } "rfResult";
  } "rfResultsRef";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapTMB: DNPM tmb → MII_PR_MTB_Mutationslast (Observation)
// Profile code: $LNC#94076-7
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapTMB(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "tmbId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "tmbStatus";
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-mutationslast' "tmbProfile";
  } "tmbMeta";
  // Category: laboratory
  src -> tgt.category as cat then {
    src -> cat.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "tmbCatSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'laboratory' "tmbCatCode";
    } "tmbCatCoding";
  } "tmbCategory";
  // Code: LOINC 94076-7
  src -> tgt.code as c then {
    src -> c.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "tmbCodeSys";
      src -> coding.code = '94076-7' "tmbCodeCode";
      src -> coding.display = 'Mutations/Megabase [# Ratio] in Tumor' "tmbCodeDisplay";
    } "tmbCodeCoding";
  } "tmbCode";
  // Subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "tmbSubjectRef";
  } "tmbSubject";
  // Specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as s then {
    spec.id as sid -> s.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "tmbSpecimenRef";
  } "tmbSpecimen";
  // valueQuantity: value + unit
  src.value as v -> tgt.valueQuantity as vq then {
    v.value as valueV -> vq.value = cast(valueV, 'string') "tmbVQValue";
    v.unit as unitV -> vq.unit = cast(unitV, 'string') "tmbVQUnit";
    src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "tmbVQSys";
    src -> vq.code = '1/1000000{Base}' "tmbVQCode";
  } "tmbValueQuantity";
  // Interpretation
  src.interpretation as interp -> tgt.interpretation as tgtInterp then {
    src -> tgtInterp.coding as c then {
      interp.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "tmbInterpCode";
      interp.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "tmbInterpSys";
      interp.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "tmbInterpDisplay";
    } "tmbInterpCoding";
  } "tmbInterpretation";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapBRCAness: DNPM brcaness → MII_PR_MTB_BRCAness (Observation)
// Profile code: $mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker#brcaness
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapBRCAness(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "brcaId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "brcaStatus";
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-brcaness' "brcaProfile";
  } "brcaMeta";
  // Category: laboratory
  src -> tgt.category as cat then {
    src -> cat.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "brcaCatSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'laboratory' "brcaCatCode";
    } "brcaCatCoding";
  } "brcaCategory";
  // Code: MII biomarker CS
  src -> tgt.code as c then {
    src -> c.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "brcaCodeSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'brcaness' "brcaCodeCode";
      src -> coding.display = 'BRCAness' "brcaCodeDisplay";
    } "brcaCodeCoding";
  } "brcaCode";
  // Subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "brcaSubjectRef";
  } "brcaSubject";
  // Specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as s then {
    spec.id as sid -> s.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "brcaSpecimenRef";
  } "brcaSpecimen";
  // valueQuantity: BRCAness score
  src.value as v -> tgt.valueQuantity as vq then {
    v -> vq.value = v "brcaVQValue";
    src -> vq.unit = 'Score' "brcaVQUnit";
    src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "brcaVQSys";
    src -> vq.code = '1' "brcaVQCode";
  } "brcaValueQuantity";
  // Confidence range → two components (min / max)
  src.confidenceRange as cr -> tgt.component as compMin then {
    src -> compMin.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "brcaMinCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = 'brcaness-confidence-range-min' "brcaMinCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'BRCAness Confidence Range Minimum' "brcaMinCodeDisplay";
      } "brcaMinCodeCoding";
    } "brcaMinCode";
    cr.min as minVal -> compMin.valueQuantity as vq then {
      minVal -> vq.value = minVal "brcaMinValue";
      src -> vq.unit = 'Score' "brcaMinUnit";
      src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "brcaMinSys";
      src -> vq.code = '1' "brcaMinCode2";
    } "brcaMinVQ";
  } "brcaConfMin";
  src.confidenceRange as cr -> tgt.component as compMax then {
    src -> compMax.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "brcaMaxCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = 'brcaness-confidence-range-max' "brcaMaxCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'BRCAness Confidence Range Maximum' "brcaMaxCodeDisplay";
      } "brcaMaxCodeCoding";
    } "brcaMaxCode";
    cr.max as maxVal -> compMax.valueQuantity as vq then {
      maxVal -> vq.value = maxVal "brcaMaxValue";
      src -> vq.unit = 'Score' "brcaMaxUnit";
      src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "brcaMaxSys";
      src -> vq.code = '1' "brcaMaxCode2";
    } "brcaMaxVQ";
  } "brcaConfMax";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapHRDScore: DNPM hrdScore → MII_PR_MTB_HRD_Score (Observation)
// Profile code: $LNC#107286-7
// Components: LOH ($NCIT#C18016), TAI ($NCIT#C129774), LST ($NCIT#C120466)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapHRDScore(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "hrdId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "hrdStatus";
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-hrd-score' "hrdProfile";
  } "hrdMeta";
  // Category: laboratory
  src -> tgt.category as cat then {
    src -> cat.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "hrdCatSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'laboratory' "hrdCatCode";
    } "hrdCatCoding";
  } "hrdCategory";
  // Code: LOINC 107286-7
  src -> tgt.code as c then {
    src -> c.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "hrdCodeSys";
      src -> coding.code = '107286-7' "hrdCodeCode";
      src -> coding.display = 'Homologous recombination deficiency status analysis [Presence] in Tissue by Molecular genetics method' "hrdCodeDisplay";
    } "hrdCodeCoding";
  } "hrdCode";
  // Subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "hrdSubjectRef";
  } "hrdSubject";
  // Specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as s then {
    spec.id as sid -> s.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "hrdSpecimenRef";
  } "hrdSpecimen";
  // valueInteger: HRD composite score
  src.value as v -> tgt.valueInteger = v "hrdValue";
  // Interpretation
  src.interpretation as interp -> tgt.interpretation as tgtInterp then {
    src -> tgtInterp.coding as c then {
      interp.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "hrdInterpCode";
      interp.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "hrdInterpSys";
      interp.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "hrdInterpDisplay";
    } "hrdInterpCoding";
  } "hrdInterpretation";
  // Component: LOH ($NCIT#C18016)
  src.components as comps -> tgt then {
    comps.loh as lohVal -> tgt.component as comp then {
      src -> comp.code as c then {
        src -> c.coding as coding then {
          src -> coding.system = 'http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl' "hrdLohSys";
          src -> coding.code = 'C18016' "hrdLohCode";
          src -> coding.display = 'Loss of Heterozygosity' "hrdLohDisplay";
        } "hrdLohCodeCoding";
      } "hrdLohCode2";
      lohVal -> comp.valueInteger = lohVal "hrdLohValue";
    } "hrdLOHInner";
  } "hrdLOH";
  // Component: TAI ($NCIT#C129774)
  src.components as comps -> tgt then {
    comps.tai as taiVal -> tgt.component as comp then {
      src -> comp.code as c then {
        src -> c.coding as coding then {
          src -> coding.system = 'http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl' "hrdTaiSys";
          src -> coding.code = 'C129774' "hrdTaiCode";
          src -> coding.display = 'Telomeric Allelic Imbalance Region' "hrdTaiDisplay";
        } "hrdTaiCodeCoding";
      } "hrdTaiCode2";
      taiVal -> comp.valueInteger = taiVal "hrdTaiValue";
    } "hrdTAIInner";
  } "hrdTAI";
  // Component: LST ($NCIT#C120466)
  src.components as comps -> tgt then {
    comps.lst as lstVal -> tgt.component as comp then {
      src -> comp.code as c then {
        src -> c.coding as coding then {
          src -> coding.system = 'http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl' "hrdLstSys";
          src -> coding.code = 'C120466' "hrdLstCode";
          src -> coding.display = 'Large-Scale State Transition' "hrdLstDisplay";
        } "hrdLstCodeCoding";
      } "hrdLstCode2";
      lstVal -> comp.valueInteger = lstVal "hrdLstValue";
    } "hrdLSTInner";
  } "hrdLST";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapSimpleVariant: DNPM simpleVariants[*] → MII_PR_MTB_Einfache_Variante
// Uses MII_PR_MolGen_Variante component slice names from the parent profile
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapSimpleVariant(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation, source ngsReport : BackboneElement) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "svId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "svStatus";
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-einfache-variante' "svProfile";
  } "svMeta";
  // Category: laboratory + GE
  src -> tgt.category as cat then {
    src -> cat.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "svCatLabSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'laboratory' "svCatLabCode";
    } "svCatLabCoding";
  } "svCategoryLab";
  // Code: LOINC 69548-6 (Genetic variant assessment)
  src -> tgt.code as c then {
    src -> c.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svCodeSys";
      src -> coding.code = '69548-6' "svCodeCode";
      src -> coding.display = 'Genetic variant assessment' "svCodeDisplay";
    } "svCodeCoding";
  } "svCode";
  // valueCodeableConcept: Present (LA9633-4) – standard for genomics variant assessment
  src -> tgt.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
    src -> vc.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svVCCSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'LA9633-4' "svVCCCode";
      src -> coding.display = 'Present' "svVCCDisplay";
    } "svVCCCoding";
  } "svVCC";
  // Subject (from parent ngsReport.patient)
  ngsReport.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "svSubjectRef";
  } "svSubject";
  // External identifiers → component[variation-code] ($LNC#81252-9)
  src.externalIds as eid -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svVarCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '81252-9' "svVarCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Discrete genetic variant' "svVarCodeDisplay";
      } "svVarCodeCoding";
    } "svVarCode";
    eid -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {
        eid.value as valueV -> c.code = cast(valueV, 'string') "svVarCCCode";
        eid.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "svVarCCSys";
      } "svVarCCCoding";
    } "svVarCC";
  } "svExternalIds";
  // component[chromosome-identifier]: LOINC 48001-2
  src.chromosome as chr -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svChrCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '48001-2' "svChrCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Cytogenetic (chromosome) location' "svChrCodeDisplay";
      } "svChrCodeCoding";
    } "svChrCode";
    chr -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {
        chr -> c.code = chr "svChrVCCCode";
        src -> c.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/chromosome-human' "svChrVCCSys";
      } "svChrVCCCoding";
    } "svChrVCC";
  } "svChromosome";
  // component[gene-studied]: LOINC 48018-6
  src.gene as gene -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svGeneCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '48018-6' "svGeneCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Gene studied [ID]' "svGeneCodeDisplay";
      } "svGeneCodeCoding";
    } "svGeneCode";
    gene -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {
        gene.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "svGeneVCCCode";
        gene.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "svGeneVCCSys";
        gene.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "svGeneVCCDisplay";
      } "svGeneVCCCoding";
    } "svGeneVCC";
  } "svGene";
  // component[representative-transcript-ref-seq]: LOINC 51958-7
  src.transcriptId as tid -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svTransCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '51958-7' "svTransCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Transcript reference sequence [ID]' "svTransCodeDisplay";
      } "svTransCodeCoding";
    } "svTransCode";
    tid -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {
        tid.value as valueV -> c.code = cast(valueV, 'string') "svTransVCCCode";
        tid.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "svTransVCCSys";
      } "svTransVCCCoding";
    } "svTransVCC";
  } "svTranscript";
  // component[dna-region] (exonId): LOINC 47999-8
  src.exonId as exon -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svExonCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '47999-8' "svExonCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'DNA region name [Identifier]' "svExonCodeDisplay";
      } "svExonCodeCoding";
    } "svExonCode";
    exon -> comp.valueString = exon "svExonValue";
  } "svExon";
  // component[exact-start-end]: LOINC 81254-5
  src.position as pos -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svPosCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '81254-5' "svPosCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Variant exact start-end' "svPosCodeDisplay";
      } "svPosCodeCoding";
    } "svPosCode";
    pos -> comp.valueRange as vr then {

      } "svPosLow";
      pos.end as e -> vr.high as high then {
        e -> high.value = e "svPosEndValue";

    } "svPosRange";
  } "svPosition";
  // component[ref-allele]: LOINC 69547-8
  src.refAllele as ref -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {

  // component[alt-allele]: LOINC 69551-0

  // component[representative-coding-hgvs]: LOINC 48004-6
  src.dnaChange as dna -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svDnaCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '48004-6' "svDnaCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'DNA change (c.HGVS)' "svDnaCodeDisplay";
      } "svDnaCodeCoding";
    } "svDnaCode";
    dna -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {
        dna -> c.code = dna "svDnaVCCCode";
        src -> c.system = 'http://varnomen.hgvs.org' "svDnaVCCSys";
      } "svDnaVCCCoding";
    } "svDnaVCC";
  } "svDnaChange";
  // component[representative-protein-hgvs]: LOINC 48005-3
  src.proteinChange as prot -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svProtCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '48005-3' "svProtCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Amino acid change (pHGVS)' "svProtCodeDisplay";
      } "svProtCodeCoding";

    prot -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {

        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svRdCodeSys";

        src -> coding.display = 'Allelic read depth' "svRdCodeDisplay";
      } "svRdCodeCoding";
    } "svRdCode";
    rd -> comp.valueQuantity as vq then {
      rd -> vq.value = rd "svRdValue";
      src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "svRdSys";
      src -> vq.code = '1' "svRdUCUM";
    } "svRdVQ";
  } "svReadDepth";
  // component[sample-allelic-frequency]: LOINC 81258-6
  src.allelicFrequency as af -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {

        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "svAfCodeSys";

  // interpretation: ClinVar

      interp.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "svInterpDisplay";

      src -> coding.code = 'laboratory' "cnvCatCode";

    } "cnvTcnCode";
    tcn -> comp.valueQuantity as vq then {

      src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "cnvTcnSys";
      src -> vq.code = '1' "cnvTcnUCUM";
    } "cnvTcnVQ";
  } "cnvTotalCopyNumber";
  // component[relative-copy-number]
  src.relativeCopyNumber as rcn -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "cnvRcnCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = 'relative-copy-number' "cnvRcnCodeCode";

    rcn -> comp.valueQuantity as vq then {
      rcn -> vq.value = rcn "cnvRcnValue";
      src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "cnvRcnSys";
      src -> vq.code = '1' "cnvRcnUCUM";
    } "cnvRcnVQ";
  } "cnvRelCopyNumber";
  // component[cna] (copy number allele A)
  src.cnA as cna -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "cnvCnaCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = 'copy-number-allele-a' "cnvCnaCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Copy Number of Allele B' "cnvCnaCodeDisplay";
      } "cnvCnaCodeCoding";
    } "cnvCnaCode";
    cna -> comp.valueQuantity as vq then {
      cna -> vq.value = cna "cnvCnaValue";
      src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "cnvCnaSys";
      src -> vq.code = '1' "cnvCnaUCUM";
    } "cnvCnaVQ";
  } "cnvCNA";
  // component[cnb] (copy number allele B)
  src.cnB as cnb -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "cnvCnbCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = 'copy-number-allele-b' "cnvCnbCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Copy Number of Allele A' "cnvCnbCodeDisplay";
      } "cnvCnbCodeCoding";
    } "cnvCnbCode";
    cnb -> comp.valueQuantity as vq then {
      cnb -> vq.value = cnb "cnvCnbValue";
      src -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "cnvCnbSys";
      src -> vq.code = '1' "cnvCnbUCUM";
    } "cnvCnbVQ";
  } "cnvCNB";
  // component[gene-studied]: LOINC 48018-6 (0..* affected genes → one component per gene)
  src.reportedAffectedGenes as rag -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "cnvGeneCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '48018-6' "cnvGeneCodeCode";

      } "cnvGeneCodeCoding";
    } "cnvGeneCode";
    rag -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {
        rag.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "cnvGeneVCCCode";
        rag.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "cnvGeneVCCSys";
        rag.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "cnvGeneVCCDisplay";
      } "cnvGeneVCCCoding";
    } "cnvGeneVCC";
  } "cnvGenes";
  // component[reported-focality]
  src.focality as foc -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "cnvFocCodeSys";

      } "cnvFocVCCCoding";
    } "cnvFocVCC";
  } "cnvFocality";
  // component[cnv-type]
  src.type as t -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'https://bwhc.de/mtb/cnv-type' "cnvTypeCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = 'type' "cnvTypeCodeCode";
      } "cnvTypeCodeCoding";
    } "cnvTypeCode";
    t -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {

        t.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "cnvTypeVCCSys";
        t.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "cnvTypeVCCDisplay";
      } "cnvTypeVCCCoding";
    } "cnvTypeVCC";
  } "cnvType";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapDNAFusion: DNPM dnaFusions[*] → MII_PR_MTB_DNA_Fusion
// Components: five-prime-chromosome, three-prime-chromosome,
// five-prime-position, three-prime-position,
// five-prime-gene, three-prime-gene,
// allelic-read-depth
// All component codes from mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker

group MapDNAFusion(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation, source ngsReport : BackboneElement) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "dfId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "dfStatus";
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {

  } "dfMeta";
  // Category: laboratory
  src -> tgt.category as cat then {
    src -> cat.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "dfCatSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'laboratory' "dfCatCode";

  // Code: LOINC 69548-6

  } "dfSubject";
  // component[five-prime-gene]

      src -> comp.code as c then {
        src -> c.coding as coding then {
          src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "df5GCodeSys";
          src -> coding.code = 'five-prime-gene' "df5GCodeCode";

      } "df5GCode";
      gene5 -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
        src -> vc.coding as c then {
          gene5.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "df5GVCCCode";
          gene5.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "df5GVCCSys";
          gene5.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "df5GVCCDisplay";
        } "df5GVCCCoding";
      } "df5GVCC";
    } "df5PrimeGeneInner";
  } "df5PrimeGene";
  // component[three-prime-gene]
  src.fusionPartner3prime as fp3 -> tgt then {
    fp3.gene as gene3 -> tgt.component as comp then {
      src -> comp.code as c then {
        src -> c.coding as coding then {
          src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "df3GCodeSys";
          src -> coding.code = 'three-prime-gene' "df3GCodeCode";

      } "df3GCode";
      gene3 -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
        src -> vc.coding as c then {
          gene3.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "df3GVCCCode";
          gene3.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "df3GVCCSys";
          gene3.display as displayV -> c.display = cast(displayV, 'string') "df3GVCCDisplay";
        } "df3GVCCCoding";
      } "df3GVCC";
    } "df3PrimeGeneInner";
  } "df3PrimeGene";
  // component[five-prime-position]
  src.fusionPartner5prime as fp5 -> tgt then {
    fp5.position as pos5 -> tgt.component as comp then {
      src -> comp.code as c then {
        src -> c.coding as coding then {
          src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "df5PCodeSys";
          src -> coding.code = 'five-prime-position' "df5PCodeCode";

      } "df5PCode";
      pos5 -> comp.valueRange as vr then {

          pos5 -> low.value = pos5 "df5PosLowValue";
        } "df5PosLow";
        pos5 -> vr.high as high then {
          pos5 -> high.value = pos5 "df5PosHighValue";
        } "df5PosHigh";
      } "df5PosRange";
    } "df5PrimePositionInner";
  } "df5PrimePosition";
  // component[three-prime-position]
  src.fusionPartner3prime as fp3 -> tgt then {
    fp3.position as pos3 -> tgt.component as comp then {
      src -> comp.code as c then {
        src -> c.coding as coding then {
          src -> coding.system = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker' "df3PCodeSys";

      } "df3PosRange";

  // component[allelic-read-depth]: LOINC 82121-5 (reportedNumReads)
  src.reportedNumReads as reads -> tgt.component as comp then {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapRNAFusion: DNPM rnaFusions[*] → MII_PR_MTB_RNA_Fusion
// Components: five-prime-gene, five-prime-transcript-id, five-prime-exon-id,
// five-prime-position, five-prime-strand,
// three-prime-gene, three-prime-transcript-id, three-prime-exon-id,
// three-prime-position, three-prime-strand,
// variation-code, allelic-read-depth
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapRNAFusion(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation, source ngsReport : BackboneElement) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "rfId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "rfStatus";
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-rna-fusion' "rfProfile";
  } "rfMeta";
  // Category: laboratory
  src -> tgt.category as cat then {
    src -> cat.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "rfCatSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'laboratory' "rfCatCode";
    } "rfCatCoding";
  } "rfCategory";
  // Code: LOINC 69548-6
  src -> tgt.code as c then {
    src -> c.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "rfCodeSys";
      src -> coding.code = '69548-6' "rfCodeCode";
      src -> coding.display = 'Genetic variant assessment' "rfCodeDisplay";
    } "rfCodeCoding";
  } "rfCode";
  // valueCodeableConcept: Present
  src -> tgt.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
    src -> vc.coding as coding then {
      src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "rfVCCSys";
      src -> coding.code = 'LA9633-4' "rfVCCCode";
      src -> coding.display = 'Present' "rfVCCDisplay";
    } "rfVCCCoding";
  } "rfVCC";
  // Subject (from parent ngsReport.patient)
  ngsReport.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "rfSubjectRef";
  } "rfSubject";
  // component[variation-code]: external IDs (e.g. COSMIC)
  src.externalIds as eid -> tgt.component as comp then {
    src -> comp.code as c then {
      src -> c.coding as coding then {
        src -> coding.system = 'http://loinc.org' "rfVarCodeSys";
        src -> coding.code = '81252-9' "rfVarCodeCode";
        src -> coding.display = 'Discrete genetic variant' "rfVarCodeDisplay";
      } "rfVarCodeCoding";
    } "rfVarCode";
    eid -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vc then {
      src -> vc.coding as c then {
        eid.value as valueV -> c.code = cast(valueV, 'string') "rfVarVCCCode";
        eid.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "rfVarVCCSys";
      } "rfVarVCCCoding";
    } "rfVarVCC";
  } "rfExternalIds";
  // ---- 5' fusion partner ----
  // component[five-prime-gene]
  src.fusionPartner5prime as fp5 -> tgt then {
    fp5.gene as gene5 -> tgt.component as comp then {
